items.text: Bills ruled out WR DJ Moore due to a shoulder injury sustained in the TNF game vs Lions; he was questionable to return after landing hard and going for X-rays with a stinger.
items.why: Shoulder injury and stinger in first half; ruled out mid-game.
items.implication: Bills WR corps thins; monitor snap/target redistribution in remaining game and ROS if multi-week.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for other Bills pass-catchers if available.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey DNP second straight day (ribs from Week 1 hit); unlikely available Week 2 vs Raiders. Has yet to practice this week.
items.implication: WR1 absence opens targets for Johnston/Harris; Herbert efficiency hit.
items.opportunity: Slot/volume to Quentin Johnston and Tre Harris.

items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) DNP Thursday (second straight); Ja'Kobi Lane (fractured wrist) on IR. If Flowers out, Ravens WR hierarchy: Bateman, Devontez Walker, Wester, Sarratt, Chris Moore.
items.why: Hamstring re-aggravation Week 1; consecutive DNPs. Lane IR confirmed.
items.implication: Bateman flex upside; Lamar/Andrews target share rises. Lane out multi-weeks.
items.opportunity: Clear hierarchy elevates Bateman to primary if Flowers sits.

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins injured hamstring in Wednesday practice; doctors do not believe it serious (Grade 1), but DNP Thursday and Week 2 status vs Bengals in jeopardy. Missed 5 games on IR with hammy in 2024.
items.why: Hamstring strain in practice; history of soft-tissue issues.
items.implication: High-end WR2 risk; if out, Hutchinson/Boutte/Noel/Schultz see boosts.
items.opportunity: Routes last week: Collins 37/42 dropbacks; backups ready for volume if absent.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson 'ready to go' after ankle; unclear how much he earns vs Rhamondre Stevenson. Perfect timing: AJ Brown IR (high ankle, ~6 weeks), strong upcoming schedule (PIT/JAX/BUF/LV/NYJ etc before bye).
items.why: Ankle healed; Pats desperate for explosives with Brown IR; schedule soft.
items.implication: Handcuff/committee upside; monitor split for RB2/flex value.
items.opportunity: Goal-line/third-down potential expansion; explosive plays needed.
items.conflict: Unclear share vs Stevenson; not full takeover guaranteed.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers DNP again Thursday (knee surgery last week); has yet to practice since. Unlikely Week 2 vs Chargers.
items.implication: TE void; Mayer or others for volume; sit Bowers.
items.opportunity: Michael Mayer TE upside if Bowers out.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty LOVE @ LAC: Utilization Score 99 (tied Bijan lead W1). 19% tgt share last 10; 25+ touches 3/4 recent. Overreaction to injury scare possible; Kubiak scheme fit.
items.why: Elite util score; consistent high volume/targets.

items.text: Kenneth Walker LOVE vs IND: 21/24 RB touches through 3Q (74% snaps), 24% tgt share (tied lead, 2nd-career high), 40% routes targeted. IND allowed 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry. RB1 overall range of outcomes if healthy.
items.why: Elite W1 usage/target share in Chiefs debut; soft IND run D.
items.opportunity: 24% tgt + high snap/touch share = every-down role.

items.text: Dalton Kincaid LOVE vs DET: 69% route participation (higher than any 2025 game), 77% snaps (highest since W9 2024). Top-5 TE util W1; DET allowed 27 to TEs. Efficient per-target; breakout if healthy role sticks. Derek Brown: top 3-5 TE easily as FT player.
items.why: Career-high routes/snaps; soft DET TE D; efficiency history.
items.implication: TE1 start/upgrade; buy low if available.

items.text: Nico Collins hamstring history (5 games missed 2024); Week 1 routes 37 of 42 Stroud dropbacks. MRI/crucial results pending; jeopardy for Week 2. Backups Hutchinson 29, Boutte 27 routes.
items.why: Hammy pull history + current practice miss; high prior route share.
items.implication: Sit/monitor; beneficiaries gain flex/TE1 upside if OUT.
items.opportunity: 37/42 routes show clear WR1 role when healthy; volume redistributes heavily if out.

items.text: DeVonta Smith LOVE @ TEN: 27% tgt share, 13.7 aDOT (3 deep) W1. TEN allowed 85% catch/16 YPR to NYJ; 6th-most PPG to WRs since last year. Bounce-back incoming.
items.why: Solid W1 usage + elite matchup vs TEN secondary.
items.opportunity: High aDOT + target share vs soft D.

items.text: Dak Prescott on Week 2 LOVE list despite soft W1; home vs WAS (torched for 14.5 YPC/3 TDs W1), top-5 implied total (27), high game total 50.5. Smash spot, top-3 QB play.
items.why: Home splits strong; WAS secondary poor; high totals.

items.text: Bucky Irving LOVE vs CLE: Career-high 26% tgt share W1, 8 more routes than Gainwell, all RB RZ touches. CLE allowed 121 rush/4.8 YPC. RB9 util.
items.why: Clear lead over Gainwell in routes/RZ; soft CLE front.

items.text: Justin Jefferson LOVE @ CHI: 37% tgt share from Wentz W1; 93 rec yds/18 PPG avg in 6 career games with Wentz. CHI D allowed 10+ YPT to CAR WRs.
items.why: Elite share + historical Wentz chemistry; soft matchup.
